name: What is the difference between natural stone and porcelain tile flooring?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between natural stone and porcelain tile flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Natural stone is quarried directly from the earth, showcasing unique variations in color, pattern, and texture. It offers a luxurious, one-of-a-kind appearance but typically requires sealing and can be more porous. Porcelain tile is a manufactured product made from clay and other materials, fired at high temperatures. It is generally more uniform in appearance, highly durable, water-resistant, and requires less maintenance. Your choice depends on aesthetic preference, maintenance commitment, and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Natural stone is unique and porous, requiring sealing; porcelain tile is manufactured, uniform, durable, and low-maintenance.
